cards.title: Interval Data (Urine) NCA Formulas
cards.claim: For interval data (e.g., urine), excretion rate is calculated as (Concentration * Volume) / (Ending Time - Starting Time). Lambda Z is estimated using midpoints of collection intervals vs. log excretion rates. Amount_Recovered is the cumulative amount eliminated.
limitations: Midpoint is used for time axis in regression.
AURC_INF is theoretically equal to Amount_Recovered but differs due to experimental error.
cards.downstream_use: Renal clearance estimation; mass balance analysis.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
